gpu_gate_recommendation: Do not launch DriftRot smoke until C1-C4 show drift-conditioned headroom relative to fixed ParoQuant. Run ParoQuant Falcon/DeepSeek first.

driftrot_scale_clip_retune.gate: Proceed only with calibration/confirmation split and held-out ParoQuant improvement in median, CI lower, or CVaR tail.
driftrot_scale_clip_retune.kill_if: Only retunes ParoQuant knobs on calibration traces or lacks held-out gain.

drift_aware_pairing.gate: Proceed only if pairings materially differ from ParoQuant baseline and predicted range reduction is confirmed.
drift_aware_pairing.kill_if: Pairings are equivalent to static high-low/ParoQuant or gains are calibration-only.

rotated_residual_correction.gate: Proceed on weak/tail traces only; no kernel until partial evaluation survives.
rotated_residual_correction.kill_if: Does not fix ParoQuant tail or loses matched overhead.

branchrot.gate: Proceed if branch-local drift/covariance is at least 0.15 better than post-mixer and recovery improves.

msurface_rotation_protection.gate: Proceed if internal surface leaving is <0.30-0.40 or at least 0.15 below block output.
msurface_rotation_protection.kill_if: No more stable internal surface is found.

safe_global_claim: Long-decode drift diagnostics can be used to decide whether and where an existing rotation family should be retuned, corrected, or applied; held-out improvement over a fixed ParoQuant baseline is required for a positive method claim.
